title: I Might Be An Idiot
subtitle: Based on True Events
author: Rachel Marie Hannon
about_lead: I Might Be An Idiot follows my determined search for popularity as I maintain trails in Arizona following a suspension from my private arts Pennsylvania college.
about_second: When things get worse it forces me to search for the reason why all these things kept happening to me. In the end… well, you read the title.
